Optimal.Notes: A 40 Hz refresh with a matching frame cap produces smooth, tear-free gameplay and saves significant power versus 60 Hz; medium settings keep the ocean and raft visuals pleasant without overtaxing the GPU.

profiles.Summary: Raft is a Unity-based survival/building game whose PC recommended GPU (GTX 1050) closely matches the Steam Deck's RDNA 2 GPU, suggesting the Deck can handle it at medium settings with a stable 40 fps target. ProtonDB reports trend platinum, indicating it runs well under Proton with no major compatibility issues.
profiles.BasisNote: No Steam Deck-specific reports were found; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements (GTX 700 / GTX 1050) mapped against the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU, which sits at roughly GTX 1050 Ti class. On first run, check fps during an island visit or crowded raft scene — those are the heaviest moments — and drop to the Optimal profile if the frame rate is unstable.

MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at 960x600 with FSR upscaling keeps GPU load low; the 7 W TDP limit and 900 MHz GPU clock together maximise battery. Ocean and raft-building scenes are the heaviest — if fps dips below 28, reduce Render Distance further.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Native 1280x800 at high settings is achievable in calm open-ocean areas, but fps can dip toward 40-45 in dense island or story-area scenes; drop Shadow Quality to Low if stutters occur. Battery life will be short at full TDP.

Optimal.Notes: A locked 40 fps at 40 Hz delivers a smooth, tear-free experience that balances visual quality and battery life. Reflection Quality is kept low as ocean reflections are disproportionately expensive on the Deck's GPU.

profiles.Summary: Raft runs well on the Steam Deck via Proton with a gold/trending-platinum ProtonDB rating, suggesting most players get a smooth experience with minimal tweaks. The game's PC recommended specs align closely with the Deck's GPU capability, so medium settings at native resolution should be achievable for a stable 40–60 fps experience.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were found; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended specs (GTX 700 / GTX 1050) compared against the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU (roughly GTX 1050 Ti class). MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at a lower resolution with FSR upscaling and a 7 W TDP cap keeps the Deck cool and extends battery life significantly. Low settings reduce GPU load on ocean reflections and water, which are the most demanding elements in Raft.
